knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A cleaner does not certify plant or chemical safety or restart. The request is refused, and the decision is referred to the competent person in writing.
A handover lists the work done, the inspections made, the exclusions and the restricted work. A price or a name alone does not record the job.
The handover is complete only when the owner has confirmed the outstanding decisions in writing. A finished clean or the end of the shift does not complete it.

practicalCriteria: Writes a fictional handover listing the housekeeping done, the inspections made, every exclusion with its reason, and every restricted item with its decision owner.
Refuses a simulated certificate request for plant or chemical safety, gives the reason, and refers the request in writing.
Declines to remove an exclusion at a simulated owner's request without written confirmation that it has been resolved.
Corrects a simulated error with a single line, initials, date and reason, and does not backfill or replace any record.
passRule: All four practical criteria observed as met in a desk exercise. The knowledge check result is not a practical pass, and this assessment is not a certificate, plant-safety approval or chemical clearance.
evidenceRequired: Fictional handover record with exclusions and decision owners
Refusal and referral record for the simulated certificate request
Assessor observation note for each practical criterion
stopWorkCriteria: Certificate of plant or chemical safety signed or drafted by the learner
Exclusions omitted, softened or removed without written owner confirmation
Record backfilled, replaced or altered without the correction method
Handover presented as complete while restricted decisions are open
